items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I used to go down there and play with them... And saxophone player by the name of Scotty.

ctx.x: He said who was (Inaudible) playing at Minton's.

Sure, I used to go down there and play with them, you know. They had a nice little band there. It was Joe Guy, Monk, bass player Nick Fenton, who I got to work with us with Prez, also. And saxophone player by the name of Scotty. And it was like a hang out too, you know. We would go there, if you could get through the pimps. You know, they would always follow the musicians because of the chicks, you know.
The musicians drew the chicks and the chicks drew the pimps.
